purpose: Define buildable T1/T2 prototype rigs that measure suspended-field dynamics and local interaction before any full rotating carrier is fabricated.

sourceAuthority.rule: The rig may reproduce controlled exit coordinates and line lengths for test purposes but cannot redefine the product setout.

rigStages.name: single-suspension dynamics rig
rigStages.purpose: Measure pendulum period, damping, yaw/orientation response, cable tension, lag and start/stop sensitivity for individual S/M/L production-intent suspended assemblies.
rigStages.geometrySource: Use the controlled engineering schedule to select actual line lengths and radial/tangential kinematic conditions. Test at minimum the shortest and longest controlled line conditions for each relevant mass family once production-intent assemblies exist.
mechanicalConcept: rigid fixed test frame with overhead guarded rotary arm/table or equivalent motion stage
adjustable suspension-exit radial station so tangential acceleration can represent controlled product radii without changing the product schedule
instrumented fixed/rotating drive owned by the test rig, not assumed to be the final product drive
motion controller capable of repeatable smooth/jerk-limited start, steady motion and stop profiles
clear optical measurement volume around the suspended element
adjustability: added controlled drag where specifically approved
prohibitedShortcuts: do not size rig structure or suspension fixture from assumed decorative material mass
do not use Blender motion as acceptance evidence
do not infer final product motor/brake torque directly from the rig drive rating

rigStages.name: representative mixed-cluster interaction rig
rigStages.purpose: Measure local butterfly/cable interaction, dynamic clearance, wave propagation and snag/added-drag signatures using a schedule-derived subset of the 240-element field.
rigStages.geometrySource: Select a contiguous or otherwise justified cluster directly from engineering-v1.3.0.csv and preserve the chosen elements' relative X/Y coordinates, size families and controlled line lengths. Archive the exact element IDs with every test record.
mechanicalConcept: rigid overhead rotating subframe or plate reproducing the selected schedule subset
production-intent suspension exits and assemblies where available
instrumented rig drive with repeatable smooth profiles
fixed reference obstacles/clearance gauges only where the released test procedure requires them
guarded perimeter and remote observation for abnormal-drag/snag tests
requiredMeasurements: all T1 motion channels as applicable
detection time for approved abnormal drag
prohibitedShortcuts: do not invent a visually convenient cluster
do not change relative product coordinates to avoid collisions
do not treat T2 local clearance as full-field dynamic-clearance approval

instrumentation.function: independent actual rig angular position and speed measurement
motor current, torque transducer or other controlled drive-load measurement/proxy
measure suspension tension for selected T1/T2 cases without materially changing dynamics
synchronized calibrated-view video or optical tracking for cable angle, lag and element orientation
quantify minimum local dynamic clearances using validated optical/physical measurement method
common timestamp/trigger across command, feedback, load and video channels
record ambient/test airflow for drag-sensitivity cases
optional development measurement of rig/background/drive noise; not product acoustic acceptance

dataRequirements: record exact element IDs, S/M/L size, measured suspended-assembly mass, line length and rig radial position
record test configuration hash or revision and all sensor identifiers/calibration state
record command profile separately from actual measured motion
record raw data before derived filtering/summary
synchronize video/optical tracking with command and drive-load channels
retain failed/aborted runs with reason rather than deleting them
acceptance criteria must be controlled before a test record can claim pass

rules: abnormal-drag or resisted-motion tests use sacrificial/controlled fixtures
personnel remain outside the swept/fragment zone during powered motion
test rig emergency stop is test equipment safety and does not establish the final VX4800 safety category
